about: Golden pictures: P0 rendered the recipe-v2 pipeline on core's f64 reference engine before the CHB-037 cut-off; since P2b each case is a format-3 document (document.json, translated from its recipe.json) compiled by contract 1.0 and rendered on the reference engine alone. See tools/goldens/README.md.

tolerance.note: largest |Δ| allowed per float32 sample; the reference engine reproduces the files exactly

negative.title: Synthetic colour negative, 16-bit TIFF 96 × 64: rebate, neutral ramp, seven patches, fine grating, highlight blob, three dust specks (tools/goldens/fixtures.ts)

camera.title: Synthetic camera file, linear camera RGB float32 96 × 64 with its SourceInfo (camera matrix, as-shot neutral): the same scene, three sensor-dust specks

Finishing clarity +0.4, radius 12 px (finishing.clarity)
Print tone: exposure +0.3, an S-curve on L, levels on blue, vibrance (one OkLab run, one linear run)
Print colour: HSL bands, colour grading (teal shadows, warm highlights), a channel mixer at 0.7
Masked layers: a curve under a radial mask, exposure under a colour range intersected with a gradient, a vignette, sharpening
Blend modes and groups: multiply, screen, soft light, luminosity and colour layers; an isolated luminosity group under a mask; a pass group at 0.6
Black and white from the colour negative: a monochrome mixer with a red filter, levels, split toning by colour grading
The scene stage of a camera file: exposure under a highlight luminance mask (reading scene.input), a curve on R, HSL, then the film; a print vignette

White balance before the film (CHB-048): 3200 K, +10 in Lightroom's units on the balanced camera file, whose light is about 5400 K: the film sees a scene corrected for a much warmer light, so the print goes blue (display mean 0.30 0.53 0.64 against cam-auto's 0.51 0.47 0.38 with no correction)
